subject: Confirmation of Hotel Reservation
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your reservation at the Grand Hotel for the dates of your stay from October 15th to October 18th. Your deluxe room with a sea view has been secured. Please note that your credit card will be charged for the first night's stay as a deposit. If you have any special requests or need to make changes, please let us know at least 48 hours in advance. We look forward to welcoming you! Best regards, The Grand Hotel Team
